# AWS SNS Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the AWS SNS Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.awssnstrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the AWS SNS Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate AWS SNS Trigger node into your workflows.

[AWS SNS](https://aws.amazon.com/sns/) is a notification service provided as part of Amazon Web Services. It provides a low-cost infrastructure for the mass delivery of messages, predominantly to mobile users.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [AWS credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/aws) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [AWS SNS Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/aws-sns-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}

## Events <a href="#events" id="events"></a>

* New AWS SNS event

## Related resources <a href="#related-resources" id="related-resources"></a>

n8n provides an app node for AWS SNS. Refer to the [AWS SNS node documentation](/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.awssns) for more information.

View [example workflows and related content](https://n8n.io/integrations/aws-sns-trigger/) on n8n's website.

Refer to [AWS SNS's documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/api/Welcome.html) for details about their API.
